@help-how-1: Each agent is one Claude Code running separately on this PC. Anywhere from 1 to 8 work at the same time.
@help-how-2: Write a task in the Prompt screen and pick where to send it. Auto-assign sends it to the least busy agent, All sends the same task to everyone.
@help-how-3: Watch agents read and edit files live in Activity. Each pane has an input line at the bottom for talking to just that agent.
@help-how-4: Careful actions like running commands show an approval request at the bottom right.
@help-perm-2: Always allow — won't ask again for the same command in this conversation.
@help-perm-3: Deny — tells it not to. The agent looks for another way.

Running more agents uses up Claude usage that much faster.
@help-tip-2: All agents under the prompt box changes every agent's model, effort, speed and permissions at once. To change just one, use Agents.
@help-tip-3: Speed: Fast ↯ runs Opus up to 2.5x faster, but it's billed from paid usage credits, not your plan's usage. Without credits turned on, it runs at normal speed.
여러 에이전트가 같은 폴더에서 같은 파일을 고치면 서로 덮어쓸 수 있어요: If several agents edit the same file in the same folder, they can overwrite each other. Split their roles or give them separate folders.
@help-tip-5: Agents remember their conversation. For something completely different, press New conversation in Agents.
검은 서버 창을 닫으면 앱이 꺼져요. 설정과 기록은 기록 폴더(설정 창의: Closing the black server window quits the app. Settings and history stay in the data folder (Settings › Storage).
@help-gpt-1: Pick a GPT model in the model box and that agent works with Codex. It uses your ChatGPT login (free plan included) and costs nothing extra.
@help-gpt-2: GPT can't ask for approval, so it only edits files inside the work folder. With the 'Plan only' or 'Ask every time' permission it only reads.
@help-gpt-3: Pick GPT as the supervisor model to split the work: Claude builds, GPT checks. A different AI misses less.
@help-gpt-4: When an agent's AI changes (Claude ↔ GPT ↔ fallback AI), the new AI first gets a handoff note with the last task, the last message and the files that were edited.
@help-gpt-5: Press ⇄ on an agent's pane in Activity to hand it over to another AI on the spot. The current task stops and the new AI continues it; a last task that failed (e.g. on the Claude usage limit) is redone by the new AI.
대체 AI 모드 (Claude 사용량이 바닥났을 때): Fallback AI mode (when Claude usage runs out)
@help-fb-1: Press Open CCR settings in Settings. The claude-code-router page opens in your browser.
@help-fb-2: Add every AI you want under Providers. e.g. Codex (ChatGPT login), Kimi, OpenRouter (your key + openrouter/free). Don't apply the last Connect agent step — just close the tab. Applying it sends every Claude Code on this PC through CCR.
@help-fb-3: Press Start under Server, then press Import from CCR next to CCR key in the control room's Settings. (If that fails, paste the key value from API Keys in the CCR page.)
@help-fb-4: In the control room's Settings, turn on Continue with a fallback AI, press Test connection, then click models into Order in the order you want.
@help-fb-after: From then on, when Claude hits its limit the agent switches to the first AI in the order, which gets a handoff note and continues the task. If that AI gets stuck too it moves on to the next, and the stuck AI is skipped for 15 minutes. You can also switch by hand under AI connection in Agents. Conversations with the fallback AI are remembered separately from Claude's.
